永恒万界主最新章节_第11章 刚到青玉宗第1页_永恒万界主凡尘中的陌路人_热点小说网
> 第11章 刚到青玉宗（第1页）
陈晓云看过后，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，没有关系的，姐姐不在乎别人怎么说。”姬云生一听也是无奈了，心里喃喃道：“我去，这小丫头姐姐不会喜欢上我了吧？我如今可是要算年龄的话，我也才半岁啊！这不会是把我当童养夫了吧？”
陈晓云突然想到了什么，打趣笑着温柔脸红问道：“弟弟，我问你个问题，要是以后弟弟真的找到自己的家人，你会忘记了我吗？”姬云生一听写道：“不会，你和陈叔对我而已，可是救命之恩，我可不是个忘恩负义之辈。”陈晓云一听顿时心里暖暖的，
但还是有些不满意这个答案，又温柔笑着问道：“弟弟，要是以后姐姐有生命危险，你又打不过对方？你会如何做呢？”姬云生一听写道：“那又如何，救命之恩定当涌泉相报，打不过又如何，要死也是我死在你前面。”陈晓云一听虽然感动，还是不满意答案，
温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，要是那个人是你喜欢之人呢？”姬云生一听顿时明白了，然后写道：“我不是傻子，喜欢是喜欢，那可不是爱。只是单论喜欢的话，要是对方的所作所为，让你受到生命危险，我肯定不会手软的。毕竟那可不是爱，喜欢只是单纯的被对方样貌吸引而已，
那毕竟对我而已只是一个无关之人。当然了，要是说爱的话，那就要看情况了，一般而言我能爱上之人，必须要有重要步骤过后，我才会毫无保留。不然的话，我可不会相信对方也是爱自己的。姐姐，你不会是打算把我当童养夫吧？”陈晓云看完后，顿时脸红起来，
温柔笑着说道：“姐姐可对你没有那方面的意思，姐姐希望能陪自己渡过余生的，那必须是个盖世人物，即使不是那也是，要对得起姐姐。不会像姐姐的娘亲一般，把姐姐丢弃在爹爹手中，十年多时间一面都不肯来见我。如果连这都做不到的话，姐姐宁愿孤独一生。”
她说着说着顿时又伤心起来了，仔细看的话，能看到她眼睛凝聚的水雾。姬云生一听写道：“那好吧，姐姐，既然你那么想你的娘亲，那就好好修炼到化神修为。我想到时候，你知晓一切后，你会知道缘由的，或许会是你心中的期待。”陈晓云看完后，
顿时收起情绪，温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，好了，我们还是聊点别的吧。”姬云生写道：“好。”在剩下的时间之中，陈晓云和姬云生聊了很多，姬云生也是在纸张上回答她，当然了，该笑的时候，姬云生也是脸上带着笑容和笑声的。半天时间很快过去，
等他们的飞舟到达青玉宗宗门外后，陈晓云也是去叫醒陈明，然后通报了下，就缓慢控制飞舟速度前往，她在宗门之中的所在。等到地方后，她安排两人住下之后，就前往她师尊的住所而去了。姬云生一路上看着这优美的环境，心里也是一阵感慨：“不愧是修仙者所居住的地方，
这环境简直太美了，不过晓云姐，这直接带我和陈叔来这里住下，怎么感觉要出事呢？一路上过来，在这山峰之中，我好像就没有看到一个男弟子或者男性。”然后写道：“陈叔，我们直接在这里住下，不会给姐姐带来麻烦吧！这好像都没有一个男的，除了我们两人之外。”
陈明看过之后，笑着说道：“云生，不必担心，我想你姐姐应该提前和她师尊说过了，应该是不会有什么麻烦的。毕竟你姐姐的师尊，在青玉宗可不是弱者，哪怕是在这整个元阳王朝，都是顶尖强者的。一般而言，可不会有什么人会自找麻烦。”

> Chapter 11 Just arrived at Qingyu Sect (Page 1)
After Chen Xiaoyun saw it, he said with a gentle smile: "Brother, it doesn't matter, sister doesn't care what others say." Ji Yunsheng was helpless when he heard it, and murmured in his heart: "Come on, this little girl won't like me, will she? If you count my age now, I'm only half a year old! Doesn't this mean that she treats me as a child adoptive husband?"
Chen Xiaoyun suddenly thought of something, and asked with a joking smile and a gentle blush: "Brother, let me ask you a question, if my brother really finds his family in the future, will you forget me?" When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he wrote: "No, you and Uncle Chen only treated me, but I am not an ungrateful person for saving my life." When Chen Xiaoyun heard this, he felt warm in his heart.
But he was still a little dissatisfied with the answer, and asked with a gentle smile: "Brother, if my sister's life is in danger in the future and you can't beat her? What will you do?" Ji Yunsheng wrote: "So what, the life-saving grace will definitely be repaid by the spring. So what if you can't beat me. Even if I die, I will die in front of you." Although Chen Xiaoyun was moved after hearing this, he was still not satisfied with the answer.
He smiled softly and said, "Brother, what if that person is the one you like?" Ji Yunsheng understood immediately when he heard it, and then wrote: "I am not a fool. Liking is liking, but that is not love. Just talking about liking, if what the other person does puts your life in danger, I will definitely not be merciful. After all, that is not love. Liking is just being attracted by the other person's appearance.
After all, he is just an irrelevant person to me. Of course, when it comes to love, it depends on the situation. Generally speaking, I can fall in love with someone only after important steps have been taken before I have any reservations. Otherwise, I would not believe that the other person also loves me. Sister, are you planning to treat me as a child adopter? "After Chen Xiaoyun read it, he immediately blushed,
She said with a gentle smile: "Sister, I don't mean that to you. I hope that the person who can spend the rest of my life with me must be a great person. Even if he is not that, he must be worthy of my sister. He will not be like my mother, who abandoned her in the hands of her father and refused to see me for more than ten years. If she can't even do this, my sister would rather live alone."
She suddenly became sad again as she spoke. If you look carefully, you can see the mist in her eyes. When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he wrote: "Well, sister, since you miss your mother so much, then practice hard to become a god. I think in time, after you know everything, you will know the reason, and maybe it will be the expectation in your heart." After Chen Xiaoyun read it,
He immediately put away his emotions and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, okay, let's talk about something else." Ji Yunsheng wrote: "Okay." In the remaining time, Chen Xiaoyun and Ji Yunsheng chatted a lot, and Ji Yunsheng also answered her on the paper. Of course, when it was time to smile, Ji Yunsheng also had a smile and laughter on his face. Half a day passed quickly,
After their flying boat arrived outside the Qing Jade Sect, Chen Xiaoyun also went to wake up Chen Ming, then informed her, and then slowly controlled the speed of the flying boat to go to her location in the sect. After arriving at the place, she arranged for the two of them to stay, and then went to her master's residence. Ji Yunsheng looked at this beautiful environment along the way and sighed in his heart: "It is indeed a place where immortal cultivators live.
This environment is so beautiful, but Sister Xiaoyun, why do you feel like something is going to happen if you bring me and Uncle Chen to live here directly? Along the way here, I didn't seem to see a single male disciple or male in this mountain peak. "Then he wrote: "Uncle Chen, we will live here directly and will not give it to my sister.Sister, bring trouble! There didn't seem to be any men here, except for the two of us. "
After Chen Ming read it, he said with a smile: "Yunsheng, don't worry, I think your sister should have told her master in advance, so there shouldn't be any trouble. After all, your sister's master is not a weakling in the Qingyu Sect. Even in the entire Yuanyang Dynasty, he is the top strong one. Generally speaking, no one would ask for trouble. "
